title: English Practice Quiz 0792
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Telephone Skills 01: When answering a workplace call, first?
questions.explanation: Option D is correct: identify the organisation or department.

questions.question: Telephone Skills 02: Before placing a caller on hold,?
questions.explanation: Option C is correct: ask permission and explain briefly.

questions.question: Telephone Skills 03: A telephone message should include?
options: the caller's name and accurate contact details
questions.explanation: Option B is correct: the caller's name and accurate contact details.

questions.question: Telephone Skills 04: An angry caller should be met with?
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: a calm and respectful tone.

questions.question: Telephone Skills 05: Before transferring a call,?
questions.explanation: Option D is correct: explain the transfer and destination.

questions.question: Telephone Skills 06: A dropped call involving an urgent matter should be?
questions.explanation: Option C is correct: handled under the workplace procedure.

questions.question: Telephone Skills 07: Confidential information requested by phone requires?
questions.explanation: Option B is correct: verification and authorisation.

questions.question: Telephone Skills 08: A professional phrase for a short hold is?
options: May I place you on a brief hold?
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: May I place you on a brief hold?.

questions.question: Telephone Skills 09: A voicemail greeting should provide?
options: your name or department and instructions
questions.explanation: Option D is correct: your name or department and instructions.

questions.question: Telephone Skills 10: At the end of a service call,?
options: confirm the next step and close courteously
questions.explanation: Option C is correct: confirm the next step and close courteously.
